def priority(d, p, mean_d, max_d, lam, progress, stagnation, best_ratio):
    return d / (1 + p)

def priority(d, p, mean_d, max_d, lam, progress, stagnation, best_ratio):
    return (d / mean_d - 0.5) / (1 + p) ** 2

def priority(d, p, mean_d, max_d, lam, progress, stagnation, best_ratio):
    return d / (1 + p + 0.1 * max_d / mean_d)

def priority(d, p, mean_d, max_d, lam, progress, stagnation, best_ratio):
    return (d - 4 * lam * p) / (1 + p)

def priority(d, p, mean_d, max_d, lam, progress, stagnation, best_ratio):
    return log1p(2 * d / mean_d) / (1 + p) ** 1.5

def priority(d, p, mean_d, max_d, lam, progress, stagnation, best_ratio):
    return d / (1 + p) + 0.5 * mean_d * p / (1 + p)

def priority(d, p, mean_d, max_d, lam, progress, stagnation, best_ratio):
    return (d / mean_d) ** 3 / (1 + p) ** 2

def priority(d, p, mean_d, max_d, lam, progress, stagnation, best_ratio):
    return d / (1 + p + 0.5 * (progress + stagnation))

def priority(d, p, mean_d, max_d, lam, progress, stagnation, best_ratio):
    return d / (1 + p + 0.5 * stagnation)

def priority(d, p, mean_d, max_d, lam, progress, stagnation, best_ratio):
    return (d / mean_d - 1.5) / (1 + p) ** 0.5

def priority(d, p, mean_d, max_d, lam, progress, stagnation, best_ratio):
    return d / (1 + p + 1 * max_d / mean_d)

def priority(d, p, mean_d, max_d, lam, progress, stagnation, best_ratio):
    return (d - 1 * lam * p) / (1 + p)
